Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Extend the Soul's Boundaries
Cards.Text:
This card enters play paying 1 less Gold for each Ring you control.
Battle: Destroy this card, bow this Shugenja, destroy him unless he is Void, and target an enemy Personality: His controller may shuffle him and his attachments back into their owners' decks. If he did not choose this, take two additional Battle actions.

Cards.Name: Immolation
Cards.Text: This Shugenja has +3F, or +4F while he is Fire.

Cards.Name: Master of Beasts
Cards.Text: Battle/Open: Even if this card is not at the current battlefield, bow this Shugenja and target one or two Shadowlands Nonhumans: Straighten them.

Cards.Name: Nature's Wrath
Cards.Text:
If this Shugenja is Earth, he may perform this card's Battle action even if it is in your home.
Battle: Bow this card and target your Nonhuman Personality: If he would be opposed, move him to the current battlefield. Straighten him if he moved.

Cards.Name: Peace of the Kami
Cards.Text:
If this Shugenja is Water, he may perform this card's Battle action even if it is in your home.
Battle: Bow this card and target your Personality or Follower: Negate all current effects on it from other players' cards. Negate its (current and new) Force penalties from actions. If it is a Spirit, straighten it.

Cards.Name: Scent of Dishonor
Cards.Text: Open: Bow this Shugenja unless he is Air, destroy this card, and target a Kolat, Ninja, Shadowlands, or dishonorable Personality: Bow him.

Cards.Name: The Earth's Strength
Cards.Text:
Battle: Bow this card and target your Earth or Water Shugenja: Straighten him. Gain 1 Honor if he is an Alchemist and opposed.
Reaction: Before an action resolves, bow this card and target a defending Personality: Negate his movement from the action's effects.
